'''Steven Butler''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Austin tournament (25 August)]] on 25 August 2001 with Asteroid Sanctuary, according to Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2892">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-austin-texas-08-25-01d2892/ austin-texas-08-25-01], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 25 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-austin-texas-08-25-01d2892/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
